title: Record who entered a decision and how the owner gave it, beside who decided

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: ork decided adj 170 (`process.owner-answers`, 2026-10-25): an agent may record, as decided, an option the owner explicitly picked in an interactive question, with `--by` set to the owner and a `--why` that cites the session and date. ork's relays used this for adj 150-170 and later answers. The record then cannot tell an owner's own `adj decide` from an agent's transcription of an owner's pick, except by parsing `--why`. The slicer relay contract work (slicer s399, owner answers path) relies on this being traceable.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Proposed, for the owner: `adj decide ... --recorded-by NAME --via TEXT` (for example `--via "interactive question, session ID"`), stored with the decision and shown by `show` and `list --json`. Both optional; leaving them out keeps today's records unchanged (C27: decided_by never required).
